title: WikiArticle
description: Single wiki entry for a map marker. One file per marker name. The same shape is used for successful fetches, missing wiki pages, and transport errors so consumers don't branch on response form.

name.description: Marker name. Matches the value used in data/Faerun/<layer>.json properties.name and is the lookup key the frontend uses to find this file.

status.description: ok = article fetched and html is non-null. missing = wiki returned a missingtitle/similar 'no such page' error. error = transport or unexpected response failure.

title.description: Canonical wiki title for the article, null when status != ok.

pageId.description: MediaWiki page id, null when status != ok.

html.description: Sanitized article HTML ready to inject into the popup. Image-bearing markup has already been stripped. Null when status != ok.

error.description: Populated when status != ok. code is the MediaWiki/HTTP error code; info is a human-readable message.

url.description: Full URL the article was fetched from (MediaWiki action=parse endpoint).

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this file was written.
